SELECT e.id
, _utf8mb4'MEAL' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS type , DATE(e.consumed_at) AS event_date, e.consumed_at AS occurred_at , e.source_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_name , CONVERT(e.food_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS summary
, JSON_OBJECT('mealType', e.meal_type, 'foodName', e.food_name, 'portionAmount', e.portion_amount, 'portionUnit', e.portion_unit, 'calorieMode', e.calorie_mode, 'caloriesKcal', e.calories_kcal, 'referenceAmount', e.reference_amount, 'referenceCaloriesKcal', e.reference_calories_kcal, 'nutritionSource', e.nutrition_source, 'note', e.note) AS details_json
FROM meal_records e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
AND e.id = #{id}
AND e.consumed_at >= #{q.startDate} AND e.consumed_at <= TIMESTAMP(#{q.endDate}, '23:59:59.999999')
UNION ALL

, JSON_OBJECT('amountMl', e.amount_ml, 'note', e.note) AS details_json

SELECT e.id
, _utf8mb4'DIARY' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS type , DATE(e.recorded_at) AS event_date, e.recorded_at AS occurred_at , e.source_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_name , CONVERT('记录健康日记' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS summary
, JSON_OBJECT('mood', e.mood, 'stressLevel', e.stress_level, 'bodyFeeling', e.body_feeling, 'events', e.events, 'tags', e.tags, 'note', e.note, 'agentAllowed', CAST(IF(e.agent_allowed, 'true', 'false') AS JSON)) AS details_json
FROM diary_entries e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.id
, _utf8mb4'CHECKIN' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS type , DATE(e.checked_at) AS event_date, e.checked_at AS occurred_at , _utf8mb4'计划打卡' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_name , CONVERT(i.title USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS summary
, JSON_OBJECT('planId', p.id, 'planTitle', p.title, 'itemTitle', i.title, 'scheduledDate', CAST(e.date AS CHAR), 'checkedAt', REPLACE(CAST(e.checked_at AS CHAR), ' ', 'T')) AS details_json
FROM checkins e JOIN plan_items i ON i.id = e.item_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = i.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
AND e.id = #{id}
AND e.checked_at >= #{q.startDate} AND e.checked_at <= TIMESTAMP(#{q.endDate}, '23:59:59.999999')
AND _utf8mb4'计划打卡' = CONVERT(#{q.sourceName} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
UNION ALL

SELECT e.id
, _utf8mb4'PLAN_CREATED' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS type , DATE(e.created_at) AS event_date, e.created_at AS occurred_at , _utf8mb4'计划管理' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_name , CONVERT(e.title USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS summary
, JSON_OBJECT('planId', e.id, 'planTitle', e.title, 'startDate', CAST(e.start_date AS CHAR), 'endDate', CAST(e.end_date AS CHAR), 'createdAt', REPLACE(CAST(e.created_at AS CHAR), ' ', 'T')) AS details_json
FROM plans e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
AND e.id = #{id}
AND e.created_at >= #{q.startDate} AND e.created_at <= TIMESTAMP(#{q.endDate}, '23:59:59.999999')
AND _utf8mb4'计划管理' = CONVERT(#{q.sourceName} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
UNION ALL

SELECT e.id
, _utf8mb4'PLAN_STATUS' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS type , DATE(e.changed_at) AS event_date, e.changed_at AS occurred_at , _utf8mb4'计划管理' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS source_name , CONVERT(CONCAT(CASE e.status WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN '暂停' WHEN 'ENDED' THEN '结束' ELSE '恢复' END, ' · ', p.title) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS summary
, JSON_OBJECT('planId', p.id, 'planTitle', p.title, 'previousStatus', e.previous_status, 'status', e.status, 'changedAt', REPLACE(CAST(e.changed_at AS CHAR), ' ', 'T')) AS details_json
FROM plan_status_changes e JOIN plans p ON p.id = e.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
AND e.id = #{id}
AND e.changed_at >= #{q.startDate} AND e.changed_at <= TIMESTAMP(#{q.endDate}, '23:59:59.999999')
AND _utf8mb4'计划管理' = CONVERT(#{q.sourceName} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
UNION ALL
